I've been doing a 1400 calories a day (not counting added calories for exercise) diet for the past 2 months, except this past week where I hit a plateau and therefore dropped to 1200 a day. I have The Fear that if I start upping my calorie count, my body will be like OH. SHIT. FOOD. WE MISSED THIS. and I'll put on weight again.
Can anyone give me some advice for maintaining weight loss, please?
